propositions: Pause and resume operations must maintain dual-format gate blob with both new pause metadata (paused, reason, who, paused_at) and legacy gated_mode: reconcile-check for old reader compatibility
Pause operation must return exit code 0 with exact anchored JSON-decoded BRIDGE_PAUSED marker line, block before lock acquisition or ticket mutation, and be idempotent for same-reason re-pause
Resume operation must be observed-OID compare-and-swap, safely handle absent/valid/corrupt state without decoding, and preserve metadata on same-reason pause
Scheduled workflow must recognize only complete BRIDGE_PAUSED marker at rc 0 to skip commit-and-push, while rc 1 corrupt blobs recover cleanly and legacy exit 4 gate behavior remains unchanged
Pause operation must refuse overwrite on blank reason, missing identity, missing remote, different reason, or CAS conflict, using repository git user.email and first-pause UTC RFC3339 provenance
Pre-gate reconcile-check early return and legacy rebar reconcile --mode vocabulary must remain functional without modification
